name: Sugimiya Osamu
source: Gorou's client who hired him to built a house for him and his two sons at Yashirogi village, as well as Masato's cousin and Senzou's childhood friend. Kind, calm, and mature, Osamu gives out an air of friendliness and kindness to everyone around him.
